name: Lost Items & Theft
description: Что-то потерялось или украли: как сообщить и что говорить

entries.word: Excuse me, I think I lost my wallet.
entries.translation: Извините, кажется, я потерял свой кошелёк.

entries.word: I can’t find my passport!
entries.translation: Я не могу найти свой паспорт!

entries.word: My bag was stolen!
Someone stole my phone on the bus.
entries.translation: Кто-то украл мой телефон в автобусе.

entries.word: I left my phone in the taxi.
Has anyone turned in a black purse?
Did anyone find a set of keys?
It’s a small brown leather wallet.
There were documents inside.
Where is the lost and found?
When did you see it last?
entries.translation: Когда вы видели её в последний раз?

entries.word: Describe the item, please.
Can you retrace your steps?
Check with reception, maybe someone found it.
entries.translation: Спросите на ресепшене, может, кто-то нашёл.

entries.word: I’d like to report a theft.
I want to file a police report.
entries.translation: Я хочу написать заявление в полицию.

entries.word: It happened about an hour ago near the market.
entries.translation: Это случилось около часа назад возле рынка.

entries.word: He grabbed my bag and ran off.
I didn’t see his face clearly.
He was wearing a grey hoodie.
Was anyone injured?
No, nobody was hurt.
My credit cards were in the wallet.
entries.translation: В кошельке были мои кредитные карты.

entries.word: I need to block my cards immediately.
Call my bank, please.
My phone had all my contacts in it.
entries.translation: В телефоне были все мои контакты.

entries.word: Can I use your phone to call the police?
entries.translation: Можно воспользоваться вашим телефоном, чтобы вызвать полицию?

entries.word: Is there anything valuable inside?
Luckily, the documents are intact.
Thank goodness I found it!
Oh great, it was in my other pocket!
entries.translation: Отлично, оно было в другом кармане!

entries.word: Everything is here, nothing missing.
entries.translation: Всё на месте, ничего не пропало.

entries.word: Report any suspicious activity.
Be careful with your belongings.
Keep an eye on your bags.
Pickpockets work in crowded places.
